The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`). The three bugs corrected in `rtl/div_seq.v`:

1. `start` was accepted even while `busy=1`, restarting an in-progress division — now gated by `!busy`.
2. `abort` was only checked when `last_step` was false, so an abort on E8 was ignored instead of taking priority over completion — abort is now checked first on every busy cycle.
3. `div0` was computed from the live `divisor` input rather than the captured `dvs`, so changing `divisor` mid-division could alter the result — now uses `dvs`.
